question: Should this report be routed as a distinct OpenClaw missing-pending-code issue or linked to the existing persisted-approval report?
rationale: The reports overlap in Feishu pairing but fail at different stages, and ClawHub contains no runtime implementation that can establish whether their root cause is shared.

options.title: Route distinct runtime symptom
options.body: Preserve the missing pending-code lookup failure and request synchronized request-creation and approval logs in OpenClaw.

options.title: Consolidate after confirmation
options.body: Link it to the existing OpenClaw report only if runtime owners confirm both symptoms share the same account-scoped pairing-store defect.

recommendation.title: Route distinct runtime symptom
recommendation.body: Preserve the missing pending-code lookup failure and request synchronized request-creation and approval logs in OpenClaw.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest available provenance connects this contributor to the account-scoped pairing-store contract directly implicated by the failed lookup.
